description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter (ProductAdapter) using PagingDataAdapter for efficiently displaying a paginated list of Product objects in an Android UI.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying Products with paging support.

classes.name: ProductAdapter.ProductViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that binds product data to item views.

methods.name: areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks whether two Product objects represent the same item based on their IDs.

methods.name: areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks whether the contents of two Product objects are equal.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Product object to the view elements in the item layout.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ProductViewHolder with the inflated layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view holder at the given position, with a subtle appear animation.
